summary: This is a 3d planet rendering tool, showing the planets with the infrared lasers and how they compare, as well as what molecules are found in planets. You can focus on a single planet or other celestial body.
details: It visualizes different planets and stars, showing their relations with other items nearby and shows the infrared levels of each. It uses render.com as a backend to help reduce lag, and uses primarily python in a github repository.
